decision.reason: [ev-4aa7e3fe937e] is a single changelog line under Enhancements. It says only that the Gateway API provider now "handles middlewares in filters extension reference" and points to PR #10511. It doesn't name the resource or field involved (for example, which route kind or filter type), and it doesn't say how such references behaved before (rejected, ignored or errored). Without that, an engineer can't write a declarative applicability condition for which environments are exposed. The PR or Gateway API provider docs would be needed.
